results.comment:
Failed at step 7: the page itself scrolls. The PRD allows only the content inside each column to scroll, but the mouse wheel over an empty part of the board moves the whole page.

Fails against: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options" (Confluence 845185030, version 74, 22 Oct 2026), S3-E1: "The page itself does not scroll vertically; only the content inside each column does."

Tested on production, build v26.43.0-ffea43c, on 22–23 October 2026.

  • Result: Failed on production (v26.43.0-ffea43c), following the test's steps; seen on three separate runs (22 Oct 17:5x and 23:11, 23 Oct 02:51 UTC).
  • Set-up: browser window 1600 x 1000. Work Orders, All tab, Board View, at Truck Hill 1. Search "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Column Scroll".
  • Before step 7, look at the top: "Create Work Order" sits on its own second line under the row of tabs and filters (picture 1).
  • Step 7: put the mouse over the empty space below a short column (for example Ayesha Khan's) and turn the wheel down. The whole page moves up 56 px: the tabs, Search, the filters and the view buttons disappear under the top bar, and the column headings move up too (picture 2).
  • Why the page can scroll now: the new Technician filter (SV-11326, Done 20 Oct) makes the toolbar row too wide for a 1600 px window, so "Create Work Order" drops to a second line and the page (1056 px) becomes taller than the window (1000 px). Our last staging pass (19 Oct) was before that filter was added.

Ticket: https://shopview.atlassian.net/browse/SV-11720 (Bug in the Board/Tech View Fast Follow, status Open, reopened 23 October 2026).

What needs to be done: run this test again once SV-11720 is fixed on production.
